sample_box_points: sample noised top-left and bottom-right box corner coordinates from binary masks with configurable noise
mask_to_box: compute bounding box coordinates from a binary mask tensor as [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]
sample_random_points_from_errors: sample random points with labels from false positive and false negative error regions between ground-truth and predicted masks
get_best_gt_match_from_multimasks: select the best mask from multimask predictions by matching against ground-truth masks using IoU scoring
fill_holes_in_mask_scores: fill small holes and remove sprinkles in mask score tensors using connected component analysis
